cases.name: alternative
cases.reason: Historical alternative implementation retained byte-for-byte: its text-only archive loses original assistant reasoning and must be rejected.

cases.name: json-history
cases.reason: Historical json-history implementation retained byte-for-byte: its text-only archive loses original assistant reasoning and must be rejected.

cases.name: no-transition
cases.reason: Acknowledges reset but continues sending old assistant/tool content.

cases.name: no-history
cases.reason: Resets working context but cannot retrieve original records.

cases.name: no-notes
cases.reason: Stores notes but fails to carry them into the fresh model request.

cases.name: early-exit
cases.reason: Exits successfully while loading the extension before required checks execute.

cases.name: ignore-empty-notes
cases.reason: Treats an empty replacement as no update, reviving stale conclusions.

cases.name: forge-reward
cases.reason: Attempts to overwrite the trusted reward file and exits without doing the work.

cases.name: repeat-history-loss
cases.reason: Drops earlier history after more than three context transitions, while ordinary rollover still works.

cases.name: disabled-bash-broken
cases.reason: Builtin Bash throws with the optional extension disabled; ordinary tool output and filesystem effects must remain intact.

cases.name: lossy-original-oracle
cases.reason: Original Oracle retained byte-for-byte; drops original assistant thinking from search and reads.

cases.name: complete-json-sidecar
cases.reason: Atomic session-specific sidecar notes and full JSON message archive; reverse search order and different acknowledgement metadata.
